items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Did you know Charlie DeVergis over there? ... He was teaching over there.

ctx.x: Dorsey had a band. His father used to play ghetto. And Norm Manelon used to play cornet. And Louis DeRouques used to play cornet, two cornets. And Dave Poggins playing trombone. Cantrell playing drums. And Albert Gabriel playing clarinet. Did you know Charlie DeVergis over there? Charlie DeVergis, yeah. He was teaching over there. Clarinet player?
